messages.author: e8ad54d4ad5b752c
messages.subject: % signs
parts:
I have a list of numbers representing percentages for my barplot. How
do I make the axis labels add a %? I have 0-30 on the y-axis. If I
change to labels=percent on scale_y_continous, it then goes up to
3000%

messages.author: 9c9b5f9c6aaa025d
messages.subject: Re: % signs
parts: I would just divide the numbers by 100 before plotting. If you don't want to do that, then you could write your own labeling function.
